articles.title: Synology Fixes Critical Security Flaws With CVSS Scores of 9.8 and 8.1 Across NAS Platforms
articles.summary:
Synology has announced two remotely exploitable vulnerabilities affecting DiskStation Manager (DSM) and BeeStation OS. Fixes for both DSM branches are scheduled for release by November 20, 2026. The notices, dated November 19, identify a critical OAuth API vulnerability (CVE-2026-120382) and an NGINX HTTP/2 memory corruption flaw (CVE-2026-123007). articles.title: Hackers Exploit AI-Powered ARTEX Tool to Identify Vulnerabilities in European Commission IT Systems
articles.summary:

articles.title: Russian-Speaking Hackers Steal US Bank, IRS and Social Security Login Credentials From Infected PCs
articles.summary:
Russian-speaking hackers stole US banking and federal identity credentials from infected Windows PCs. The archives contained plaintext bank logins, decrypted password vaults, and authentication cookies. The investigation found no evidence that banks or federal agencies were breached. The attackers collected the credentials from victims’ computers. The records also included IRS and Social Security accounts. Among […]

articles.title: Hackers Use Legitimate Microsoft Login Pages to Steal OAuth Tokens and Hijack Microsoft 365 Accounts
articles.summary:
Attackers are using genuine Microsoft sign-in pages to hijack Microsoft 365 accounts without collecting passwords on counterfeit login forms. Once a victim approves the request, Microsoft issues OAuth tokens to the attacker-controlled client, granting access within the permissions authorized. articles.title: Apache Roller Vulnerability Allows Remote Code Execution Through Unsafe XML-RPC Deserialization
articles.summary:
The Apache Software Foundation has disclosed an actively exploited vulnerability in Apache Roller that lets remote attackers execute arbitrary code without logging in. Tracked as CVE-2026-129448, the flaw affects versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4 and carries a CVSS 3.1 score of 9.8 out of 10. Apache’s November 17 vulnerability disclosure confirms exploitation in the wild and […]
